I really enjoy using Duolingo. It’s a great app. One small issue I’ve noticed: in the word exercises, when learning German from English, some words can be both nouns and verbs. For example, “report” can be either a noun (“a report”) or a verb (“to report”), but the exercise doesn’t always make it clear which meaning is intended. It would be helpful to distinguish them somehow, for example by writing “to report” for the verb, or by indicating the part of speech.
